description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalalpitiya, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District Cad. Map No. 500600 (24/0089)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
